name: EgoVerse
tagline: Growing multi-lab robot-learning corpus: 1,362 h / 80K episodes (paper), 1,965 tasks, 240 scenes, 2,087 demonstrators, head pose + language.

annotations.format: Zarr v3 episode stores (arrays + zarr.json attrs); language spans as JSON strings in the annotations array
annotations.coverageNote: Every episode has task metadata, camera intrinsics and 6-DoF head pose; hand keypoints, wrist cams, gaze and sub-step language spans vary by contributing lab.

narrations.note: Span-based sub-step text ({text, start_idx, end_idx}); optional but encouraged

action_labels.note: task_name / task_description per episode (1,965 task types)

hand_pose.note: 21 MANO keypoints x3 per hand (obs_keypoints) when hand tracking exists

gaze.note: obs_eye_gaze unit direction vector where available (Aria)

camera_pose.note: obs_head_pose 6-DoF in SLAM world frame, required for all episodes

depth.note: EgoVerse-I industry rigs capture depth (per paper/catalog)

samples.caption: EgoVerse overview figure from the official repository
